summary: Requirements for making AppForge-LLM v4 configure and use external LLM providers through a local llm_bridge service.

in_scope: Same-origin FastAPI /api/llm proxy endpoints for provider management and active model selection
Vue provider settings UI launched from the current app header
Local Bun/TypeScript llm_bridge service with provider registry, config persistence, testing, generation, and streaming endpoints
llm-bridge AgentDriver and truthful JobManager readiness
Tests and build verification for backend, frontend, and bridge
out_of_scope: Hosted secret storage, team accounts, billing, deployment, OAuth, or production infrastructure
Replacing Codex, Claude, generic, or auto driver behavior
Guaranteeing live third-party provider success without credentials

functional_requirements.statement: The web UI must let a user open LLM connection settings from the existing top bar.
acceptance_criteria: A visible LLM connection control exists in TopBar.vue.
Activating the control renders ProviderSettings.vue as a modal/dialog.
Closing the dialog returns to the existing app without clearing the current job or prompt state.

functional_requirements.statement: The settings UI must list providers, accept API key/base URL/default model input, test a provider, delete stored keys, and activate a provider/model.
acceptance_criteria: The UI calls /api/llm/providers, /api/llm/providers/{id}/models, PUT/DELETE /api/llm/providers/{id}, POST /api/llm/providers/{id}/test, and GET/PUT /api/llm/active.
Stored keys are never shown back to the user; placeholders only identify stored or environment-backed keys.
Provider changes trigger a health refresh so readiness reflects the new state.

functional_requirements.statement: The FastAPI app must proxy LLM provider management to the configured local bridge URL and return structured bridge errors.
acceptance_criteria: FastAPI exposes same-origin /api/llm endpoints that delegate to appforge.llm_bridge.
BridgeError responses include code LLM_BRIDGE_ERROR, a user-facing message, and bridge context when available.
Tests verify endpoint delegation parameters without live provider calls.

functional_requirements.statement: APPFORGE_DRIVER=llm-bridge must be a supported driver/readiness path.
acceptance_criteria: create_driver accepts llm-bridge, llm_bridge, and llm aliases.
JobManager.health reports llm-bridge ready only when the bridge is reachable and the selected provider is configured.
Missing bridge, missing active provider, unknown provider, or unconfigured provider produce actionable setup messages.

functional_requirements.statement: The local bridge service must provide provider registry/config/active-selection/test/generate/stream endpoints.
acceptance_criteria: llm_bridge/src/server.ts exposes health, providers, provider models, upsert/delete, test, active selection, generate, and stream routes.
Unknown provider IDs are rejected for provider-specific routes and active selection.
Provider configs are stored locally outside source-controlled files.

non_functional_requirements.statement: Secrets must stay local and out of source control.
non_functional_requirements.measure: No API keys appear in committed source, tests use fake values, .env patterns remain ignored, and the bridge config path is under APPFORGE_LLM_CONFIG/APPFORGE_LLM_CONFIG_DIR/APPFORGE_DATA_DIR or ~/.appforge/llm.

non_functional_requirements.statement: The integration must preserve existing web app and driver behavior.
non_functional_requirements.measure: Existing Python suite passes and auto/codex/claude/generic branches remain available in create_driver and driver_readiness.

non_functional_requirements.statement: Frontend and bridge type contracts must be valid.
non_functional_requirements.measure: npm run typecheck, npm run build, and bun run typecheck pass.

non_functional_requirements.statement: Dependency install must be reproducible from public npm for the frontend.
non_functional_requirements.measure: frontend/package-lock.json uses registry.npmjs.org resolved URLs, matching public integrities for corrected packages, and frontend/.npmrc sets replace-registry-host=always.

user_flows: User starts llm_bridge, opens AppForge-LLM v4, clicks LLM connection, saves provider credentials, tests the provider, activates a model, and sees health become ready for llm-bridge.
User runs a job with APPFORGE_DRIVER=llm-bridge and the runner calls the active provider through bridge /generate.
User has no bridge/provider configured and receives actionable setup guidance instead of a false-ready state.
assumptions: The bridge process is started separately from the FastAPI web process.
Live provider calls require user credentials and are not exercised in automated tests.
Single-shot bridge generation is acceptable for llm-bridge driver scope.

risks.risk: Readiness could claim llm-bridge is usable when no configured provider exists.
risks.impact: Users start jobs that fail at the first stage.
risks.mitigation: Readiness calls list_providers and checks the selected provider's configured flag.

risks.risk: Provider secrets could leak through UI or tests.
risks.mitigation: Do not return stored keys to the browser; tests use placeholder fake keys only.

risks.risk: Lockfile points to unreachable internal registry.
risks.mitigation: Normalize package-lock resolved URLs and add frontend/.npmrc replace-registry-host=always.

quality_gates.evidence: Must pass the full backend/AppForge test suite.

quality_gates.gate: npm run typecheck and npm run build in frontend/
quality_gates.evidence: Must pass Vue type checking and production web asset build.
Must pass TypeScript validation for bridge code.
